nature: Post-observation diagnostic, added after longer windows exposed impossible positive finite GPU durations; not the pre-execution acceptance protocol
runtimePolicy: Accepted means measurement phase, nonzero unique increasing timestamp, positive finite CPU/GPU durations, recorded controls valid. Raw acceptance flags are preserved.
sanityDiagnostic: Flag any positive finite GPU duration in milliseconds greater than observation realtime_seconds * 1000 (the elapsed application time at observation).
rationale: The observed approximately 1.665e13 millisecond durations exceed the entire short-lived Player process by many orders of magnitude and cannot represent its rendered frames. No arbitrary percentile trim or perceptual threshold is applied.
rawRetention: No source rows, values, timestamps or original accepted flags are removed or overwritten.
interpretation: Collection/data consistency may pass while GPU timing reliability remains unestablished. Preliminary GPU mean/SD cannot be rendering-cost estimates. Equal medians do not invalidate the anomaly evidence.
futureWork: Cross-check an independently validated timing path and review the source of invalid values before freezing a benchmark validity policy. This diagnostic does not identify or repair the underlying API/driver cause.
